item.title: BREAKING: Route 333 closed due to house fire
item.description: TURBETT TOWNSHIP -- At 4:47 pm, Route 333 is closed between Tuscarora and Thompsontown due to a house fire. Crews were called to Boxwood Lane, just off Route 333 near the Turbett/Walker Township line, shortly before 4:00. When they arrived they found a working fire. Shortly after tones were sounded for defensive attack only after a side of the structure collapsed and live wires were down.This is a very active scene. More information will be passed along as it becomes available.
